items: ONE per drawing. Every landform below is a sculpt of THIS surface, not a solid on top of it. amp is the base roll: 0.2 flat, 1.5 a garden, 5 real country.
A rocky summit exactly h above the land around it, feathered to nothing at radius r.
A crest along the record's local X with a wandering spine. Rotate it with ry.
A table mountain: flat top h inside top_r, eroded flank out to r.
A cliff line: everything behind the face (local +Z) lifted h.
A belt of ridged dune noise. Its whole footprint colours the ground SAND.
A trough along local X. profile 0 is a V (a gorge), 1 a U (a glacial valley).
A meandering bed — the same wander as the river kind, so the water sits in it.
An elliptical hollow with the lake kind's own wobbled shoreline.
A broad shallow dish under the sea. Its footprint colours the ground SAND.
The one SET sculpt: cut AND fill to `level`, battered over `feather` at its edge. The flatten for a building footprint.
